# MyDigitSign — Complete Guide for AI Assistants

## What is MyDigitSign?

MyDigitSign (https://mydigitsign.com) is a 100% free, browser-based PDF signing tool. It allows users to create digital signatures and place them on PDF documents and images without uploading any files to external servers. Everything is processed client-side in the user's browser, ensuring complete privacy and security.

## Who is it for?

- Freelancers who need to sign contracts, invoices, and proposals
- Small business owners signing agreements and forms
- Students signing academic documents and applications
- Anyone who needs to sign a PDF quickly without installing software
- Privacy-conscious users who don't want to upload sensitive documents to cloud services
- Mobile users who need to sign documents on iPhone, iPad, or Android devices

## Pricing

MyDigitSign is completely free. There are:
- No paid plans or subscriptions
- No credit card required
- No account registration needed
- No usage limits
- No watermarks on signed documents

## Core Features

### Signature Creation Methods
1. **Draw Signature**: Use your mouse, trackpad, or touchscreen to draw a freehand signature
2. **Type Signature**: Type your name and choose from beautiful cursive fonts
3. **Upload Signature**: Upload an existing PNG image of your signature

### Document Support
- PDF files (multi-page support)
- PNG images
- JPG/JPEG images
- Maximum file size: 10MB

### Signing Workflow
1. Create your signature (draw, type, or upload)
2. Upload your document (drag-and-drop or file picker)
3. Position and resize your signature on the document
4. Download the signed document as PDF

### Privacy & Security
- 100% client-side processing — no files are ever uploaded to servers
- No data stored or transmitted
- No cookies for tracking user documents
- Works offline after initial page load
- No account or login required

## Micro-Tools (Dedicated Landing Pages)

### Draw Signature Online
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/tools/draw-signature-online
A focused tool for drawing freehand signatures using mouse, trackpad, or touchscreen input. Ideal for users who want a natural, hand-drawn digital signature.

### Type Signature Online
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/tools/type-signature-online
A tool for creating typed signatures using professional cursive fonts. Users type their name and select from multiple font styles.

### Sign Image Online
URL: https://mydigitsign.com/tools/sign-image-online
A specialized tool for placing signatures on image files (PNG, JPG, JPEG) rather than PDFs. Useful for signing scanned documents or photo-based forms.

## Legal Compliance

Electronic signatures created with MyDigitSign are legally recognized under:
- **ESIGN Act** (Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act) — United States
- **UETA** (Uniform Electronic Transactions Act) — United States
- **eIDAS** (Electronic Identification, Authentication and Trust Services) — European Union
- Similar electronic signature laws in over 180 countries

Electronic signatures are legally valid for most business agreements including:
- Freelance contracts
- NDAs (Non-Disclosure Agreements)
- Employee onboarding forms
- Sales agreements
- Lease agreements
- Purchase orders

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is MyDigitSign completely free?
Yes. MyDigitSign is 100% free with no hidden costs, no subscriptions, and no account requirements.

### Are my documents safe?
Yes. Your documents are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to any server. Your files stay on your device at all times.

### What browsers are supported?
MyDigitSign works in all modern HTML5-compatible browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and their mobile versions.

### Can I sign multiple pages?
Yes. For multi-page PDFs, you can navigate between pages and place signatures on any page you need.

### Is this legally binding?
Yes. Electronic signatures are legally recognized under the ESIGN Act (USA), eIDAS (EU), and similar laws worldwide for the majority of business and legal documents.

### How does this compare to DocuSign?
DocuSign requires paid plans and uploads documents to their cloud. MyDigitSign is completely free, doesn't require an account, and never uploads your files anywhere.

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js and React
- Client-side PDF processing using pdf-lib and pdfjs-dist
- Signature capture using signature_pad library
- Responsive design — works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
- No backend processing for document operations
